pitfalls.heading: Only up to ten
pitfalls.explanation: つ stops at ten (とお). From eleven on, use the thing's own counter: for small objects like apples that is 個, so 十一個 (じゅういっこ). The bare number (十一, じゅういち) is heard in casual speech, but a counter sounds more natural.

examples.jp: りんごが十一個あります。

pitfalls.heading: Ten is とお
pitfalls.explanation: The tenth is とお, not じゅうつ. Every other number from one to nine ends in つ.

examples.en: There are four people in my family.

pitfalls.heading: Four people is よにん
pitfalls.explanation: 4人 is よにん, never よんにん. 7人 is usually ななにん or しちにん.

pitfalls.heading: One and two are special
pitfalls.explanation: 1人 is ひとり and 2人 is ふたり. They do not follow the pattern; from 3人 on, the number plus にん works.

pitfalls.heading: 4時, 7時 and 9時
pitfalls.explanation: 4時 is よじ (not よんじ), 7時 is しちじ (not ななじ) and 9時 is くじ (not きゅうじ).

examples.en: I go to bed at nine.

pitfalls.heading: O'clock, not hours
pitfalls.explanation: 時 gives the time of day. A length of time is 時間: 三時間 is three hours.

pitfalls.heading: The 1st is ついたち
pitfalls.explanation: As a date the first is ついたち. As a length of time the same kanji is read いちにち; see the 日 (days) page. The two counters share their written form.

pitfalls.heading: Days 2 to 10 are special
pitfalls.explanation: ふつか, みっか, よっか, いつか, むいか, なのか, ようか, ここのか, とおか: learn them as words. Dates after the 10th are not covered here.

questions.en: What is the date today?

examples.en: I will be in Japan for three days.
How many days does it take?

pitfalls.heading: 一日 is いちにち here
pitfalls.explanation: As a length of time, 一日 is いちにち. As a date it is ついたち; see the 日 (dates) page. Two days and more are ふつか, みっか… in both.

pitfalls.heading: The 2nd and two days are both ふつか
pitfalls.explanation: The 2nd of the month and two days are both ふつか. Only the 1st differs between the two counters (ついたち and いちにち).

pitfalls.heading: Years or age?
pitfalls.explanation: 年 counts years of time. For a person's age use 歳.

pitfalls.heading: 4, 7 and 9 are special
pitfalls.explanation: 四月 is しがつ, 七月 is しちがつ and 九月 is くがつ. They are never よんがつ, ななにがつ or きゅうがつ.

pitfalls.heading: 月 is the month, か月 is how long
pitfalls.explanation: 三月 is March (さんがつ). 三か月 is three months (さんかげつ).
